description: This PHP source file defines an abstract base class 'FormElementBase' for form elements related to configuration translation in Drupal. It includes methods for generating translation UI components, handling configuration data, and managing translation-specific logic.

classes.name: FormElementBase
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common functionality for form elements involved in configuration translation within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form element with a TypedDataInterface schema element.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the class with a schema.

methods.name: getTranslationBuild
methods.description: Builds the translation form structure for a given source and target language, including source and translation elements.

methods.name: getSourceElement
methods.description: Generates a render array for displaying the source configuration value, with accessibility considerations.

methods.name: getTranslationElement
methods.description: Creates a form element for translating configuration data, handling access and formatting concerns.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets or clears configuration overrides based on whether the translated value differs from the source.
